hooks.logic:
Let bpConfsIdx be the register's 'bpConfsIdx'.
Let v2 be run helper.
If bpConfsIdx is not v2, then
  Set the register's 'bpConfsIdx' to v2.
  Set the register's 'beforeParamSuffixNo' to list at bpConfsIdx's 'paramSuffixNo'.
  Choose state list at v2's 'intState' next and stop.
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  If list at bpConfsIdx's 'paramSuffixNo' is "1", then
    Let v3 be increased the register's 'turnInPhase1BeforeLot'.
    If the numeric entry "turns_of_phase_1_to_limit_break" in the battle settings of the group of the enemy is at most v3, then
      Set the register's 'turnInPhase1BeforeLot' to 0.
      Set the register's 'beforeParamSuffixNo' to "1".
      Choose state 13 next and stop.
  The enemy → without-and-lot-and-register-ability with ({forceIgnoresReflection: false}).

yes.text: Set the register's 'beforeParamSuffixNo' to list at bpConfsIdx's 'paramSuffixNo'.
Choose state list at v2's 'intState' next.

flow.text: the enemy is ready to act

yes.text: Let v3 be increased the register's 'turnInPhase1BeforeLot'.
the numeric entry "turns_of_phase_1_to_limit_break" in the battle settings of the group of the enemy is at most v3

hooks.logic:
Count up "turnInLimitBreak".
Let bpConfsIdx be the register's 'bpConfsIdx'.
Let v2 be run helper.
If bpConfsIdx is not v2, then
  Set the register's 'bpConfsIdx' to v2.
  Set the register's 'beforeParamSuffixNo' to "2".
  Choose state list at v2's 'intState' next and stop.
Otherwise, if the numeric entry "turns_of_limit_break_to_phase_1" in the battle settings of the group of the enemy is less than the count "turnInLimitBreak", then
  Set the register's 'beforeParamSuffixNo' to "2".
  Choose state 14 next and stop.
Otherwise
  If the enemy is ready to act, then the enemy → without-and-lot-and-register-ability with ({forceIgnoresReflection: false}).
  Stop.

yes.text: Choose state list at v2's 'intState' next.

no.text: the numeric entry "turns_of_limit_break_to_phase_1" in the battle settings of the group of the enemy is less than the count "turnInLimitBreak"
the enemy is ready to act

hooks.logic:
Reset the count "turnInLimitBreak".
Queue the pose-change sequence [[{messageSuffixNo: v}], [{deformTag: "deformation_01"}]].
Put queued moves ahead of counters.

flow.text: Put queued moves ahead of counters.

Otherwise
